settings.planningNotes: Two people. Lunch is batch-cooked: 6 servings per batch (2 per person x 3 days), two batches cover Mon-Sat. Dinner is cooked once for 4 servings and eaten as leftovers the next day. Breakfast is simple: overnight oats prepped the night before, eggs & toast same-day, pancakes optional. Keep everything mild; add heat after cooking (red pepper flakes on the side). No mushrooms, no pork, no seafood beyond tuna and salmon; beef only as ground beef.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats
recipes.description: Creamy no-cook oats soaked overnight with milk, chia, and honey. Ready when you wake up.
recipes.storageNotes: Keeps up to 3 days in the fridge. Stir and loosen with a splash of milk before eating; eat cold or reheat.
recipes.notes: Prep the night before. Top with fruit, nuts, or a spoonful of yogurt.

steps.text: Divide the oats, milk, chia seeds, honey, vanilla, and a pinch of salt between two jars.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
Stir before eating, loosen with a splash of milk if thick, and add toppings.

recipes.title: Eggs & Toast
recipes.description: Soft-scrambled eggs with buttered toast, the weekday breakfast standby.
recipes.storageNotes: Best eaten fresh; refrigerate leftovers up to 1 day.
recipes.notes: Quick same-day breakfast; swap in pancakes on weekends.

steps.text: Toast the bread.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and stir gently until just set, about 3-4 minutes.
Pile the eggs onto the toast and season with more pepper if desired.

recipes.title: Pancakes
recipes.description: Fluffy everyday pancakes made from pantry staples.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days; reheat in the toaster or a dry skillet.
recipes.notes: Weekend breakfast. Serve with butter and syrup or honey.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla in a second bowl, then pour into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined (lumps are fine).
Heat a lightly greased griddle or skillet over medium heat. Pour about 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook until bubbles form and the edges look set, about 2 minutes; flip and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Serve warm with butter and syrup or honey.

recipes.title: Butter Pecan Banana Bread
recipes.description: Rich, nutty banana bread flavored like butter pecan ice cream, topped with cream cheese frosting.
recipes.storageNotes: Store frosted loaf tightly wrapped at room temp up to 3 days. Freeze unfrosted up to 2 months; thaw at room temp.
recipes.notes: Bake 55-65 min at 350F in 8x4 or 9x5 loaf pan. Cool completely before frosting. Store frosted loaf tightly wrapped at room temp up to 3 days; freeze unfrosted up to 2 months.

ingredients.originalText: 0.5 cup butter, for butter pecan mixture

ingredients.prepNote: mashed, from 3 large or 4 small very ripe
ingredients.originalText: 1.5 cup bananas, mashed, from 3 large or 4 small very ripe

steps.text: Make the butter pecan mixture: melt 1/2 cup butter in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in pecans, raise to medium. Once butter bubbles and foams, cook 2 minutes, stirring frequently and scraping the bottom. Remove from heat and transfer to a large bowl to cool 15 minutes.
During the cool-down, preheat oven to 350F. Grease and line an 8x4 or 9x5 loaf pan with parchment. Mash the bananas.

After 15 minutes, add mashed bananas, sugar, oil, and vanilla to the butter pecan mixture; whisk to combine. Whisk in eggs until fully combined, then whisk in baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add flour and fold with a spatula just until batter comes together; do not over-mix.
Pour batter into prepared pan. Bake 55-65 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes in pan, then lift out with parchment to a cooling rack; cool completely.
Make frosting: beat cream cheese until smooth, then beat in butter ~15 seconds. Add powdered sugar, salt, vanilla, and heavy cream; beat 2 minutes until fluffy.
Assemble: dollop frosting over cooled loaf and swirl with back of spoon. Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Easy Slow Cooker Chili
recipes.description: A hearty, rich crockpot chili with ground beef, two kinds of kidney beans, and warm spices. The slow cooker does most of the work.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate in airtight containers up to 4 days; freezes well up to 3 months.
recipes.notes: Made mild: use diced tomatoes with MILD green chilies and pass red pepper flakes on the side. Ingredient quantities are for 8 servings; scaled here to a 6-serving lunch batch.

ingredients.originalText: 2 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes with green chilies
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 (15 oz) can dark red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15 oz) can light red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large, deep non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion and saute 3 minutes, then add the garlic and saute 30 seconds longer. Scrape the onions and garlic into a 6- or 7-quart slow cooker.
Return the skillet to medium-high heat, add the beef, and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned.
Drain most of the fat, leaving about 2 Tbsp in the pan (optional), and add the beef to the slow cooker.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, tomato sauce, beef broth, chili powder, cumin, paprika, cocoa powder, sugar, and coriander. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and cook on low heat for 5-6 hours.
Stir in the dark and light red kidney beans and heat through, about 2 minutes.
Serve warm with shredded cheddar and any other desired toppings.

recipes.title: Healthy Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: Flavorful chicken tortilla soup with tender chicken thighs, black beans, fire-roasted tomatoes, and coconut milk. Topped with crispy tortilla strips.
recipes.storageNotes: Fridge; freeze. Reheat stovetop. Toppings add at serving.
recipes.notes: Kept mild: seed jalapeno, use 0.5 tsp chipotle (or omit). Toppings optional. Freezes well. Good batch lunch.

ingredients.originalText: 0.5 tsp chipotle powder, use 0.5 tsp for mild
2 can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 cup coconut milk, full fat canned
0.5 cup shredded cheddar, shredded, for serving

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Skillet
recipes.storageNotes: Fridge 4 days; reheat with a splash of water.
recipes.notes: Source serves 4; amounts scaled x1.5 for 6. Use mild salsa and go light on the taco seasoning.

ingredients.originalText: 22.5 oz black beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Brown the turkey in the oil over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 6–8 min. Stir in taco seasoning.
Add diced red pepper and cook 3 min until softened.
Stir in salsa, drained black beans and corn. Simmer 5 min.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Top with cheese, a squeeze of lime and cilantro.

recipes.title: Marry Me Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Tender chicken and penne tossed in a creamy sun-dried tomato and parmesan sauce. Ready in 30 minutes.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate tightly covered up to 4 days. Reheat gently on the stove or microwave with a splash of cream.
recipes.notes: Kept mild: skip added heat in the sauce and pass red pepper flakes at the table if desired. Uses sun-dried tomatoes, not canned tomatoes. Use freshly grated parmesan for the best melt.

ingredients.originalText: 1 1/2 pounds boneless skinless chicken, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps.text: Cook the penne according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Cut the chicken into 1-inch pieces and season with the salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook 6-8 minutes, until no longer pink and cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
Return the skillet to the heat and melt the butter. Saute the garlic 30 seconds until fragrant, then stir in the flour to make a paste.
Whisk in the chicken broth, heavy cream, and parmesan cheese.
Stir in the drained sun-dried tomatoes, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Season with more salt and pepper if needed.
Simmer the sauce a few minutes so it can thicken.
Return the chicken and cooked pasta to the skillet and stir to coat everything in the sauce.
Garnish with chopped basil and additional parmesan, then serve.

recipes.title: Ground Beef and Broccoli
recipes.description: A 30-minute ground beef and broccoli stir-fry in a sweet-savory soy sauce, served over rice.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days; freeze up to 3 months.
recipes.notes: Kept mild; use low-sodium soy sauce if sodium is a concern and pass red pepper flakes on the side. Peanut oil can be replaced with vegetable or olive oil. Ground beef is the only beef cut used.

ingredients.originalText: 1 Tablespoon peanut oil, can sub vegetable or olive
3 cups broccoli florets, washed and patted dry

ingredients.prepNote: start with 1 Tbsp, add more to taste

steps.text: Stir the cornstarch and cold water together in a covered container and set aside. Combine the beef broth, soy sauce, brown sugar, honey, garlic, ginger, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Heat the oil over medium heat. Add the broccoli and toss to coat; cook 4-5 minutes until slightly softened. Remove and set aside.

Season the beef with salt and white pepper. Cook and crumble the ground beef and onion over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through. Drain the grease, add the sliced bell pepper, and cook 1 minute.
Add the sauce mixture and bring to a gentle boil. Simmer and reduce 2-3 minutes, then shake the cornstarch mixture and stir it in slowly until the sauce reaches the desired thickness.
Reduce the heat to low, return the broccoli, and stir to combine and heat through. Serve over rice, garnished with green onions if desired.

recipes.title: Brown Sugar Garlic Air Fryer Salmon
recipes.description: Melt-in-your-mouth brown sugar garlic air fryer salmon — juicy, tender, full of flavor. Rub brown sugar + chili powder + paprika + Italian seasoning + garlic powder on salmon, air fry 400°F for 10 min skin-side down. 1 lb salmon serves 2. Great with asparagus or broccoli.
recipes.notes: Cook 10 min at 400°F skin-side down; check at 145°F internal. Asparagus can be added to basket after 5 min. Leftovers keep 3-4 days; reheat in air fryer 4-5 min at 350°F.

ingredients.originalText: 1 lb salmon fillets, fillets, skin on

steps.text: Salt and pepper the salmon.
In a small bowl, mix brown sugar, chili powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. Rub onto the salmon.
Place salmon in air fryer basket skin-side down. Cook at 400°F for 10 minutes. (Add asparagus after 5 minutes if desired.)
Check internal temp reaches 145°F; remove immediately.

recipes.title: Lemon Chicken Breast Cutlets with Dill
recipes.description: Quick stovetop lemon-garlic chicken cutlets in a dill pan sauce.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat with a splash of broth.

steps.text: Season the chicken with Italian seasoning, salt and pepper, then dredge in flour.
Heat 1 Tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through (165°F), then set aside.
Add the remaining olive oil and garlic to the pan; sauté 30 seconds.
Add lemon juice from 3 lemons and the chicken broth; scrape up the browned bits.
When the sauce bubbles (2–3 min), stir in the dill, return the chicken, and simmer 1 minute on low.
Top with green onions and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Salmon Sheet Pan Dinner
recipes.description: Skinless salmon roasted on one sheet pan with zucchini, red pepper, potato, olives, and lemon. Gluten-free and dairy-free.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 3 days. Reheat 30-60 seconds in the microwave, or 5-10 minutes in a 325F oven.
recipes.notes: Cut the onion, bell pepper, and zucchini the day before to speed up prep. A second sheet pan can be used to double the vegetables.

ingredients.originalText: 1 medium zucchini, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 red bell pepper, stem and seeds removed and sliced
1 small red onion, cut into chunks
8 ounces white potato, from 1 large potato, cut into 1/2-inch thick rounds and halved

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the zucchini, bell pepper, red onion, and potato in a mixing bowl with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, dried parsley, and dried oregano. Spread in an even layer on the baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables for 20 minutes, until partially cooked but not completely tender.
Meanwhile, drizzle the salmon fillets with olive oil and season with sweet paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Remove the pan from the oven and shift the vegetables aside to make room. Add the salmon, top each fillet with olives, and roast 15 minutes more, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Serve the salmon with the roasted vegetables and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Fall Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
recipes.description: Juicy chicken thighs roasted on one sheet pan with butternut squash, Brussels sprouts, red onion, and crumbled feta. Mild, high-protein, easy cleanup.
recipes.storageNotes: Fridge up to 4 days. Reheat oven/air fryer 350F or microwave.
recipes.notes: Kept mild; spices warm not hot. Roast 30-35 min at 425F then broil feta 2-3 min. Good for meal prep; leftovers 4 days.

ingredients.originalText: 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces

recipes.title: Ground Beef Fajitas
recipes.description: Quick ground beef fajitas with homemade fajita seasoning, bell peppers, and onion. Ready in 30 min, one skillet. Budget-friendly.
recipes.notes: Kept mild. Serve with Spanish rice, chips & dip, or burrito bowl. Filling (not tortillas) keeps 3-4 days fridge; freeze 3 months.

steps.text: Mix chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper in small bowl.
Slice bell peppers and onion into thin strips.
Brown ground beef in large skillet over medium heat. Drain excess fat.
Add fajita seasoning and water. Cook 2-3 min. Transfer beef to plate.
In same skillet, add oil, peppers, onion. Sauté 3-4 min until slightly tender.
Return beef to skillet. Stir to combine and heat through.
Finish with cilantro and lime juice. Serve in warmed tortillas with toppings.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.description: Crispy and crunchy air fryer sweet potato fries — lighter than deep-fried, naturally gluten-free, ready in under 15 minutes.
recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 5 days in an airtight container. Can freeze uncooked or cooked fries for up to 3 months; reheat from frozen in the air fryer. Reheat in air fryer until crispy.
recipes.notes: Optional garnish: fresh cilantro or grated parmesan. Dipping sauces: ranch, ketchup, honey mustard, garlic aioli, jalapeno ranch, avocado ranch, BBQ sauce, or fry sauce.

ingredients.originalText: 1 lb sweet potatoes, peeled and sliced into 1/4-inch-thick slices
1.5 tbsp olive oil, light olive oil

steps.text: Cut the sweet potatoes into 1/4-inch-thick slices, making sure they are all uniform in size for even cooking.
Add the fries to a large mixing bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and toss to combine.
In a separate dish, combine the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Sprinkle the seasoning mix over the potatoes and toss to combine.

Transfer the fries to an air fryer basket and cook in a basket-style air fryer at 375°F for about 12-14 minutes or a toaster-style air fryer at 350°F for 8-10 minutes, shaking the basket halfway. Air fry until golden brown and crisp on the outside.
Garnish with cilantro or grated parmesan if desired and serve immediately with your favorite dipping sauce.
